title: Chapter 60
content_en: MGA: Chapter 60 – Third Thunder Style“Die!”Looking at that scene, Chu Feng’s face instantly changed. It became gloomy and cold to the extreme. He hissed while looking up and bellowed, then rays of lightning shot out from his body.The lightning snakes rushed out and it was just as if they was materialized as they coiled around Chu Feng’s body. They turned as he wished and became 5 lightning dragons. They roared and crashed towards the 5 core disciples.Everything happened too fast like the flash of lightning or flint. Even Su Mei couldn’t react to what happened.
